source_findings.finding: The reviewed batched route validates batching, acquires MathModePin before CUDA device creation, and loads BF16 model storage with precision profile F.
The reviewed executor validates sequences, associations and capacity before physical execution. The batched forward path has no singleton-loop fallback or retry.
Projection inputs flatten to [B*S,K]; the projection cuBLAS batch count remains 1 rather than B.
QK and PV use contiguous F32 matrix operands with attention batch count 24*B, reaching 768 at physical B=32.

The reviewed Candle BF16/F32 helpers request CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F when the corresponding reduced-precision flags are false and reach cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx. This describes source-level requests, not proprietary library internal arithmetic.
Padding is right-sided; invalid keys receive an F32 negative-infinity mask for all queries. Pooling selects valid token states separately for each sequence.
The approved shared scanner delegation and exact deployment-description synchronization are incorporated without removing the reviewed schema, digest, deployment-equality or audit-binding checks.

Historical unchanged source-region review is inherited through the reconciled identities. Model and route regions are renewed; implementation and loader additions are identified separately in the bound inventory. Mechanical checks are distinguished from inherited semantic findings.

limitations: Acceptance is limited to the stated source-audit scope and disclosed evidence basis.
Mechanical verification establishes declared byte identities, inclusive bounds and literal-anchor containment, not Rust parsing or semantic correctness.
No runtime numerical acceptance, cross-shape bit invariance, full M4 acceptance or throughput qualification is certified.
No proprietary cuBLAS internal arithmetic or native GPU instruction content is certified.
The accepted inventory is not a claim of exhaustive semantic review of every compiled dependency or every acceptance-system module.
Historical evidence identities must remain unchanged; new evidence must not be represented as historical execution.
Changes to qualified source, dependency resolution, features, initialization routes or relevant build configuration require applicability review.
downstream_obligations: Hash the final saved audit bytes and construct the active audit identity from that digest and intended_path.
Preserve the immutable v2 artifact as historical B1 provenance.
Synchronize policy, configuration and artifact bindings to the actual issued v3 identity.
Generate new audit-dependent export, prepass, launch and executor evidence under that identity.
Complete the separately required numerical and operational acceptance procedures before claiming qualified deployment.
